title: Groups
intro: A group lets you share with a whole team in one step. A group can include people outside Acme.

sections.heading: Create a group
text: Click the gear in the top bar, then **Groups**.
steps: Type a name in the **New group name** box.

sections.heading: Add or remove members
text: Click **Open** next to a group to see who is in it.
steps: Type an email address in the box, then click **Add**.
Click **Remove** next to someone to take them out. Only the group's owner, or your administrator, can change a group.
bullets: Choose **Share to group** when you share a library or folder. See “Sharing a whole library”. People you add to the group later get the same access.
